title: Metatranscriptomics of Host/Coral-associated Bacterial Communities: Enrichment of bacterial mRNA for metatranscriptomics through sequential polyA(+)-mRNA and rRNA subtractions
author: Tignat-Perrier, Romie
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Extract DNA and RNA Simultaneously
steps.instruction: Perform a co‑extraction to isolate both genomic DNA and total RNA from the same coral tissue sample using a suitable kit or phenol‑chloroform method.

steps.title: Generate Biotin‑Labelled Anti‑sense rRNA Probes
steps.instruction: Design sample‑specific anti‑sense probes targeting eukaryotic and prokaryotic rRNA sequences, then synthesize them by in‑vitro transcription (IVT) incorporating biotin‑UTP.

steps.title: Deplete PolyA(+) mRNA with Oligo(dT) Beads
steps.instruction: Incubate the total RNA with oligo(dT)25‑coated magnetic beads to capture and remove polyadenylated eukaryotic mRNA, then collect the supernatant containing non‑polyA RNA.

steps.title: Subtract rRNA via Hybridisation
steps.instruction: Mix the polyA‑depleted RNA with the biotin‑labelled anti‑sense rRNA probes, allow hybridisation, then capture the probe‑rRNA hybrids with streptavidin‑coated beads and discard them, leaving rRNA‑depleted bacterial mRNA for downstream library preparation.
